Oltanı at, balıklardan kaçarak derine in: Cast your line, dodge fish on the way down and hook them on the way up! Free fishing game with upgrades, 5 seas, an aquarium and daily quests
Olta Ustası oyun alanı. Ok tuşlarıyla ka: Fishing Master play area. Steer the hook with the arrow keys, catch fish at the surface with Space
Olta Ustası'nda her tur \"Oltayı At\" dü: In Fishing Master every round starts with the "Cast Line" button. As the hook sinks from the boat, steer it left and right and avoid touching fish; the moment you touch one, it gets hooked, the descent ends and the line starts reeling in. If you touch nothing, the hook sinks to the end of your line. On the way up, do the opposite and touch as many fish as you can: each one gets hooked until your hook is full. Once it's full, the reel speeds up. When the hook reaches the surface the fish fly into the air; tap them or press Space to catch them before they fall. Every fish you catch earns gold, and deep-sea fish are worth much more. On a computer steer with the arrow keys or A and D; on a phone slide your finger across the play area. Press P to pause
Kayalar, batık çapalar ve buz kütleleri: Rocks, sunken anchors and ice blocks end the descent at once and nothing gets hooked. Jellyfish are sneakier: touch one on the way down and the descent ends, touch one on the way up and you drop the last fish on your hook. You start in the Cove and sail on to the Open Sea, Glacier Sea, Volcanic Rift and Deep Abyss. A new sea unlocks once you reach the target depth of your current sea. In the Volcanic Rift rising bubble currents push the hook sideways, and the Deep Abyss is dark, so you only see the area around your lantern. Each sea has three stars: reach the target depth, earn a set amount of gold in one round and catch that sea's rare creature
Altınla yedi yükseltme alırsın: misina u: Spend gold on seven upgrades: line length, hook capacity, reel speed, magnet (wider catch on the way up), shield (ignores fish bumps on the way down), auto aim (catches some surface fish for you) and boat. The boat keeps earning gold while you're away, up to 8 hours of income. Every species you catch for the first time goes into your aquarium, and catching 10 of one species gives a permanent 2% bonus to all earnings. Daily quests give gold and pearls; pearls unlock new hook skins
İlk altınlarını misina uzunluğuna yatır;: Spend your first gold on line length; you won't meet valuable fish without going deep. Watch the bottom of the screen on the way down, sharks are big and fast. On the way up, don't fill your hook with small fry, go for the valuable ones. The shield makes descents in deep seas much easier
<strong>Oyunda değilken nasıl altın kaza: How do I earn gold while I'm away? The boat upgrade stores up to 8 hours of passive income, collected when you come back. How do I unlock a new sea? Reach the target depth of your current sea once. What's different in the daily challenge? Everyone plays one round with the same fish layout and the same fixed gear; your upgrades don't apply.
